title: AI Governance Should Prioritize Control and Knowledge Boundaries Over Limiting Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2611.12941v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid proliferation of autonomously acting AI agents makes the governance of agentic systems urgent. We propose the competence circuit, summarized as IKC + KC + C, that decomposes an agent's real-world impact into three pathways: intelligence-mediated discovery, procedural know-how, and direct control. Using the canonical fast-takeoff debate as a stress test, we formalize the conditions for intelligence-mediated fast takeoff as a conjunction jointly sufficient for fast catastrophic supremacy, showing that most rely on rapid knowledge acquisition or control attainment rather than intelligence alone. We operationalize epistemic intelligence as hypothesis-selection efficiency and validate this framework via stochastic simulation on NK fitness landscapes across six scenarios spanning the conjunctive chain. translated_title: AI治理应优先关注控制与知识边界，而非限制智能本身
translated_abstract: 自主行动的AI代理迅速普及，使得对智能体系统的治理变得日益紧迫。我们提出了“能力回路”框架，概括为IKC + KC + C，将智能体在现实世界中的影响分解为三条路径：智能介导的发现、程序性技能以及直接控制。以经典的“快速起飞”争论作为压力测试，我们将智能介导的快速起飞条件形式化为一个合取命题，该命题共同足以导致“快速灾难性霸权”，并表明其中大多数条件依赖于快速的知识获取或控制能力的达成，而非单凭智能本身。我们将认知智能操作化为“假设选择效率”，并通过在NK适应度景观上、覆盖该合取链的六个场景的随机模拟验证了这一框架。得到模拟支持的解析上界表明，智能驱动的加速受制于竞争性智能比值的上限。
tldr: 本文提出“能力回路”治理框架，将AI的现实影响分解为智能发现、程序性技能与直接控制三条路径，并通过形式化分析与随机模拟论证AI治理应优先设置控制与知识边界，而非笼统限制智能。
en_tdlr: Proposing a "competence circuit" framework that decomposes AI impact into intelligence, know-how, and control pathways, this paper argues through formalization and stochastic simulations that AI governance should prioritize control and knowledge boundaries over limiting intelligence itself.
